Brotherhood, Unity and Five Year Plan

Pre-Communism: Cities with an Industrial Zone get +1 Production and +1 Science. Under Communism: +100 Production and Science in all cities. Industrial Zones output Science equal to their Production; Campuses output Production equal to their Science.
Holy Sites receive triple adjacency from Hills and Mountains. Holy Sites generate Gold equal to their Faith output. Purchase military land units with Faith from turn 1 at a 20% discount.

Monuments yield double Culture. War Weariness reduced by 50%. Early game (to Renaissance): +50% War Weariness. From Industrial Era: War Weariness is 0%. Military and siege units gain +10 Combat Strength when attacking cities or districts.
Conquered cities generate +2 Loyalty and +2 Culture per turn. Capturing a city in a Golden Age grants +1 Wildcard Policy slot for the remainder of the era.
